description: When the radar's own signals name a cutting-in car, against openpilot's camera model and radard. Cut-ins: an object-list track moves from the adjacent lane into the camera's ego lane 5-80 m ahead and becomes the nearest in-lane mover (two cars, 16.9 lane-valid moving h; 6 of 6 checked on video). Times are medians relative to the car's centre crossing the lane line.
in_path_fields: describe the already selected ACC target; 21 % of cut-in acquisitions start at level 3-4 and reach 5 a median 0.76 s later
source: research workspace SCR-935..939; exploratory, not preregistered
